feedback_use: Round 1 improved ariane133 across all seeds, especially s1, but bp_fe s1 lost 1.9% HPWL while overflow barely changed. This revision preserves the successful die-balancing rule and full step reductions when HPWL worsens, but density-gates only the progress-driven step increase so low-overflow stages are less likely to destabilize the final HPWL.
hypothesis: Damping aggressive shared-step increases near the density target should reduce bp_fe seed sensitivity while retaining the higher-overflow ariane133 gains and native backtracking safeguards.
